instruction: I need to set up Vim to display relative line numbers by default. Please search for how to enable relative line numbers in Vim and configure it for my local environment.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)
